description: We are a team of five enthusiastic students passionate about science, technology, innovation, and solving real-world environmental challenges. We are excited to explore Earth system trends using NASA data and develop creative solutions. We believe in teamwork, research, learning, and problem-solving. We welcome participants interested in coding, data analysis, GIS, design, and scientific research to join our journey!
summary: EarthVision is a project focused on identifying and understanding changes in Earth's environment using NASA Earth observation data. Our idea is to explore environmental trends such as climate change, rising temperatures, rainfall variations, vegetation loss, and changes in land cover. By analyzing satellite data and presenting the findings through simple visualizations, our project aims to help people understand how our planet is changing. This project addresses the challenge by using Earth system observations to detect patterns and environmental changes. It is important because understanding these changes can support environmental awareness and better decision-making for a sustainable future.
details: EarthVision is a project concept designed to help people understand environmental changes on Earth using satellite observations and Earth science data from NASA. Our idea is to explore changes in temperature, rainfall, vegetation and land cover over time. By presenting this information through maps, charts and simple explanations, the project aims to make environmental changes easier to understand. The main benefit is to create awareness about climate change, vegetation loss and other environmental challenges. It could help students, researchers and the public understand how our planet is changing. We prepared a demonstration website prototype and a PowerPoint presentation to explain our idea and its proposed workflow. The prototype includes an illustrative trend chart and a map section. These are examples for demonstration, not verified NASA measurements. Our proposed tools include NASA Earth observation data, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and GitHub. We also used AI assistance during the preparation of the project materials. Our creative approach is to present environmental information in a simple and understandable way. Our five-member team considered the importance of climate awareness, accessibility, teamwork and the potential use of satellite data. Our future goal is to connect the prototype with real NASA datasets and develop it into a useful environmental monitoring platform.
